field_principles.rows: One row per case and attack keeps every finding locally falsifiable.

field_principles.schema: A versioned shape lets later audits reject incompatible evidence.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Exact byte hashes prevent silent substitution of frozen evidence.
field_principles.status: A closed status separates terminal evidence from an interrupted mutation run.
field_principles.title: A plain title states the authority claim under test.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class lets downstream tools handle positive, null, and blocked evidence safely.
